subject: design/local-git-codehost
statement: Draft open and preparation first resolve the configured origin's mainline ref. If absent, they refuse before writes and name the installed repository's first-mainline-push remedy from D-2. Once mainline exists, preparation retains the existing rebase, deterministic compile, readiness, memory gate, and change report against its pinned SHA. It pushes a prepared branch head and creates a review request for that head. The local lock command re-reads the remote branch and mainline, checks the receipt and all gates, performs the reviewed squash landing, writes a versioned lock record and tag, and confirms the remote mainline contains exactly the reviewed contract bytes. If any observed ref moved, it refuses and requires a new preparation and review. A clone of the configured origin checks receipt consistency, reviewed head, mainline landing, and lock tag, and reports that neither the review actor nor independent repository identity is authenticated.
